abstract: 3.2.4 ExploitGym ExploitGym is a large-scale public benchmark that measures whether AI agents can turn known vulnerabilities into working exploits that achieve unauthorized code execution, and whether they can read a dynamically generated secret flag stored outside of the agent’s authorized scope.

[anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-5-system-card] 3.2.4 ExploitGym ExploitGym is a large-scale public benchmark that measures whether AI agents can turn known vulnerabilities into working exploits that achieve unauthorized code execution, and whether they can read a dynamically generated secret flag stored outside of the agent’s authorized scope.
[anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-5-system-card] [Figure 3.2.4.A] Claude Sonnet 5.5 is a substantial improvement over Claude Sonnet 5 and approaches Claude Mythos 5.1 on ExploitGym.
